name: aider
note: Definition/reference tags, personalized PageRank over file/name signals, and rank-then-pack repository maps. Parent and Swe2Max source inspection. Same-name ranking links should not become verified dependency facts.

name: continue
note: Artifact-specific incremental indexing and a portfolio of retrieval sources. The inspected full-text implementation uses SQLite FTS5 with trigram tokenization. Editor recency and multiuser server snapshots have different semantics.

name: zoekt
note: Positional trigrams, candidate verification, and structured match scoring. Parent re-fetched commit-pinned design and scoring sources after initial clone failures. Its documented performance goals are not measurements reproduced here.

name: scip
note: Symbols, occurrences, roles, range encodings and symbol relationships. The protocol explicitly accommodates indexers at different precision levels. The format is not a correctness guarantee or a complete call graph.

name: scip-python
note: Type-aware occurrence generation using the Pyright analyzer. Inspected by Swe2Max in the pinned checkout. Ambient dependency/toolchain discovery is separate from importing a previously generated index.

name: scip-typescript
note: TypeScript-checker-backed symbol occurrences and project handling. Inspected by Swe2Max; parent checked entry-point/project setup. Full precision can depend on the project environment.

name: repomix
note: Context packaging, tokenizer abstraction, syntax-guided compression and worker-based security checks. Parent re-fetched the listed source at the pinned commit. Compression and secret scanning retain limitations; exact tokenizer-library claims from the first draft were not carried forward.

name: ast-grep
note: Syntax-pattern matching, metavariables and root-kind filtering. Source inspected by Swe2Max. A structural match establishes syntax, not the identity or runtime behavior of the target.

name: dependency-cruiser
note: Named allowed/forbidden/required dependency rules and explicit violations. Parent and Swe2Max source inspection. Adapt the rule concept to GraphPilot facts without running arbitrary repository-provided JavaScript configuration.

name: code-graph
note: Static Python resolver option, cached lexical/graph ranking, full-text metadata lookup and structural MCP operations. Parent and Swe2Max inspection. Default environment/LSP behavior and cross-project bare-name fallback need separate treatment from GraphPilot safe ingestion.

name: GitNexus
note: Resolution-pass decomposition; resolved, suppressed and fallback-guessed outcomes; process/community views and change-oriented tools. Parent and Swe2Max source inspection. Numeric evidence weights are heuristics. This license is not an unrestricted commercial reuse grant; treat it as a source-available comparator.

name: CodeGraphContext
note: Multi-language pipeline, parse-failure accounting, per-call resolution diagnostics and debounced watching. Parent source inspection via commit-pinned raw files. Its confidence tiers and fallback policies require evaluation rather than direct promotion to verified facts.

name: codebase-memory-mcp
note: Separate extraction/enrichment passes, static test relations, explicit resource-limit failure states, staged artifacts and evaluation guidance. Parent source/docs inspection. Test naming and key/symbol matches are heuristics; published token/speed outcomes were not reproduced.

name: serena
note: Symbol-addressed navigation/reference tools over language servers. Swe2Max source inspection; parent read component licensing. Direct reuse requires checking the relevant component and obligations; a live LSP workspace is a different product mode from immutable archived-source analysis.

name: LightRAG
note: Entity/relationship-oriented retrieval and context merging, inspected by Swe2Max. The relevant pattern is diversification. Model-authored graph facts and mandatory extraction-time model calls are not proposed for GraphPilot core indexing.

name: deepwiki-open
note: Wiki organization, source-link presentation and task progress. Parent inspected commit-pinned sources. The wiki task registry is explicitly in-memory; source URLs in the inspected helper use a branch context, so retain GraphPilot durable jobs and commit-pinned evidence.

name: sourcebot
license: MIT for inspected public repository contents
note: Public configuration/deployment/schema repository, with 68 tree entries at inspection and no application runtime source in that tree. Parent API-tree/raw inspection and Swe2Max verification. Product workflow claims come from official docs; the runtime license is not inferred from this MIT file.
